music_prefix: Big-band casino noir: brass section, walking upright bass, vibraphone, brushed drums, a smoky late-night Vegas lounge with swagger. Cinematic, polished, instrumental.
sfx_prefix: Clean isolated game sound effect for a casino brawler, studio quality, no music, no voice, no long reverb tail.

assets.prompt: The main theme. Rain outside a casino at night, neon reflecting on wet pavement. Slow swing, muted trumpet melody, vibraphone answering, the band holding back as if the doors are about to open. Confident, inviting, a little dangerous.
Between fights on the casino floor. Mid-tempo walking bass, light brushed ride cymbal, vibraphone comping, brass stabs kept quiet. Relaxed but restless: the player is choosing a path.
A fight on the casino floor. Up-tempo hard swing, driving upright bass, punchy brass riffs, snare accents, a baritone sax riff under the horns. Energetic and cocky, never frantic.

The final boss, Mr. Moneybags, a casino owner. Slower, heavier, darker: low brass and trombone growls, a menacing bass ostinato, timpani hits, tremolo strings, the vibraphone gone cold. Big-band noir turned threatening.
The shop and the casino games. Playful and light: vibraphone lead, plucked bass, brushed snare, a cheeky clarinet, glockenspiel accents like a cash register. Money changing hands.
A quiet story encounter, a rest, a treasure room. Intimate: solo piano with a brushed kit far back, a muted trumpet answering now and then. Warm and reflective, a pause in the night.
Winning the run. A triumphant big-band finale: full brass fanfare, splashy drums, jubilant swing, the whole band cutting loose. Bright and celebratory.
Losing the run. A slow sorrowful blues: a lonely muted trumpet over sparse piano and bowed bass, the room emptying out. Dignified rather than tragic.
Casino floor room tone: distant slot machines chiming, chips clinking, the low murmur of a crowd, an occasional far-off cheer, air conditioning hum. Steady, no events, loopable.
A heavy slot machine lever pulled down and released: metallic clunk, spring ratchet, mechanical thunk.
A single slot machine reel snapping to a stop: a short mechanical click with a tiny metallic ring.
One clay poker chip dropped onto a small pile of chips in a wooden tray: a bright clack and a short rattle.
A slot machine jackpot: a bright ascending bell cascade, coins pouring, a triumphant chime at the top.
A handful of poker chips swept together and shuffled in a tray: quick clay clatter.
Picking up a single clay poker chip from a wooden tray with fingertips: a soft short scrape and click.
A poker chip pressed into a round socket on a card: a firm satisfying click and a tiny magical shimmer.
A poker chip tossed back into a tray of chips: a short clatter settling.
A playing card snapping face up onto felt with a soft magical shimmer.
A playing card flicked hard through the air: a sharp whoosh with a paper flutter.
A thrown playing card striking a body: a sharp paper slap with a thud.
A fast dagger slash cutting the air: a steel whoosh with a bright metallic ring.
Cashing in a stack of chips: chips sliding and clattering into a tray with a satisfying ka-ching.
A wave of playing cards fanning out across a room: a low magical whoosh with shimmering tails.
A quick rewinding whirr followed by a bright ready chime: a second chance.
A furious barrage of eight dagger slashes in quick succession, steel whooshes overlapping, ending in a thunderous final impact and a deep boom.
A soft glassy ping: a small mechanism arming.
A quick whoosh passing by with nothing struck: a swing and a miss.
A solid punch impact on a body: a meaty thud with a short crack.
A heavy blow landing on a man's chest: a dull thud with a short breath knocked out, no words.
A massive impact: a deep sub boom with a cracking transient and a short rumble.
A hit absorbed by a shield: a hard metallic clang, dull and short.
A shield of energy rising and locking into place: a rising metallic shimmer with a solid click.
A target being marked: a sharp card flick followed by a glowing hum settling.
A curse settling on someone: a downward sour tone with a hissing wisp.
Power rising: a short upward bright shimmer with a warm low thump.
Stunned: a dizzy warble of little bells circling with a dull bonk.
Healing: a warm soft chime blooming with a gentle rising sparkle.
A card turned face up to reveal an intention: a crisp paper flip with a low ominous tone under it.
A menacing wind-up before an attack: a low rising growl of tension and a foot scuff on carpet.
An enemy defeated in a casino: a burst of chips exploding and scattering across a table with a slot machine payout chime.
A summon arriving: a whoosh of air, a puff of smoke, footsteps landing on carpet.
An encore: a quick drum roll and a cymbal crash with a short brass hit.
A stone golem cracking: rock splitting, with a chip of ceramic breaking off and bouncing away.
Chips being sucked away: a reverse whoosh pulling inward, chips rattling, then a hollow pop.
A dealer busting at blackjack: cards slapped down and a sad descending buzzer.
A man collapsing onto a carpeted floor: a heavy body fall, a final exhale, a dropped glass rolling.
A deal being offered: a briefcase latch opening with a soft ominous chord.
Signing a loan: a pen scratching on paper and a heavy rubber stamp thump.
A debt come due: a deep bell toll with a metallic scrape.
Coins won: a short bright pour of gold coins into a cupped hand with a cheerful chime.
Coins lost: coins snatched off a table and swept away with a sour low note.
Passing the turn: two soft knocks of knuckles on a felt card table.
A short triumphant big-band stinger: brass fanfare, cymbal crash, one final held chord.
A short defeated stinger: a sad trombone slide and a low piano chord fading out.
A very soft short UI tick, like a fingertip brushing felt.
A crisp UI click: a poker chip tapped once on a wooden table.
A UI confirmation: a bright two-note chime with a chip click.
Picking a reward: a card drawn from a deck with a rising sparkle and a soft chime.
Buying in a shop: a cash register bell ding and coins dropped into a drawer.
Peeling and pressing a sticker onto glass: a short peel and a soft squeak of the press.
A single die shaken in a hand and rolled across a felt table, tumbling and settling.
A face-down playing card flipped over on felt: a crisp snap.
A quick riffle of a small deck of cards cut once: a short crisp shuffle.
A treasure chest opening: a creaking wooden lid, a glittering cascade of gold and a soft magical bloom.
